Vergrim's Very Spiffy Robe of Divine Power
Piece:  Body
Class:  Mage
Defense Rating:  varies with item level

Vergrim's Very Spiffy Robe of Divine Power is a mage body rainbow.

This rainbow is specific to Vergrim's lair chest. It is not in the shared mythic pool every boss rolls. The Wishing Well can also spit it out once you are high enough for Vergrim's Vexation. The full list is on Boss Lair Rainbows.

This item is soulbound.

The tooltip says it has a chance to Touch anyone who hits you with a small bit of the Divine.

Attributes:

The base item always carries:

  • + Endurance
  • + Intellect
  • + Divine Damage
  • + Total Health
  • + Total Mana
  • + Divine Damage Resistance
  • + Shadow Damage Resistance

Rolled copies can also pick up an extra ending. Those endings and their bonuses are listed on Mythic Suffixes.
